name: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd
title: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd - 543322 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 margin of 33.6% (+360bp) and revenue +6.9%, but capex stepping up to INR540 crores for FY27 with capacity planned to reach 2,690 KL by FY28; Solapur utilisation guided at only 40-50% at start.

utilisation.quote: we should start off with a robust 40% to 50% utilization and then probably take it up to 60%, 70% in the following year

capex.quote: Looking ahead to FY27, we plan to incur a capex of about INR540 crores, which includes carryover commitments from FY26 as well as fresh capital investments.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR540 crores
triggers.quote: we plan to incur a capex of about INR540 crores, which includes carryover commitments from FY26

triggers.label: Solapur start utilisation 40-50%
triggers.quote: we should start off with a robust 40% to 50% utilization and then probably take it up to 60%, 70% in the following year

triggers.label: Non-GPL price erosion ~5.5%
triggers.quote: the price erosion is about 5.5% is what we have seen on the non-GPL, non-CDMO

triggers.label: Raw-material price pass-through sought
triggers.quote: most customers are pretty comfortable taking price rises because they understand the situation
triggers.highlight: customers are pretty comfortable taking price rises

guidance.quote: we remain confident in the strength of our business fundamentals and our ability to sustain EBITDA margins in the range of 30% to 32% going forward
Solapur Phase 1 is progressing as planned and is expected to be operational in Q2 of this year
we plan to incur a capex of about INR540 crores, which includes carryover commitments from FY26
I don't think we'll cross 4%, right? We'll probably be at 4% in the next year or 2
we hope to close 2 new deals in the second half early second half of this year

prior_guidance_check.quote: it may come in the first half also, a little later in the first half. But just to be on the safe side, we are saying it will happen on the early part of second half

red_flags.quote: we are saying it will happen on the early part of second half

red_flags.label: Dahej fire, INR20 crore loss
red_flags.quote: we have booked a loss due to fire in our other expenses to the extent of INR20 crores
